239.name: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!
text: Go to the Westbrook Garrison and speak with Deputy Rainer.

240.name: Return to Jitters
text: Return to Jitters with the Dusky Crab Cakes.

243.name: Into the Field
text: Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan about getting a power source for the testing kit.

244.name: Encroaching Gnolls
text: Report to Deputy Feldon.

245.name: Eight-Legged Menaces
text: Kill 15 Pygmy Venom Web Spiders, and then report back to Watcher Dodds in Duskwood.

246.name: Assessing the Threat
text: Kill 10 Redridge Mongrels and 6 Redridge Poachers, then report back to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire.

248.name: Looking Further
text: Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.
Find a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.

249.name: Morganth
text: Defeat Morganth.
Bring his Pendant of Shadow to Theocritus at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.

250.name: A Dark Threat Looms
text: Investigate the area near the eastern ramp of the Dam and bring Chief Engineer Hinderweir a clue that might reveal what the Dark Iron Dwarves are up to.

251.name: Translate Abercrombie's Note
text: Bring the Letter to Ello to Sirra Von'Indi.

252.name: Translation to Ello
text: Bring the Translated Letter to Lord Ello Ebonlocke

253.name: Bride of the Embalmer
text: Find Eliza's grave. Retrieve the Embalmer's Heart from her, then return to Ello Ebonlocke.

255.name: Mercenaries
text: Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar has hired you to kill 4 Mo'grosh Ogres, 4 Mo'grosh Brutes and 4 Mo'grosh Enforcers.

256.name: WANTED: Chok'sul
text: Kill Chok'sul and bring his head to Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar.

257.name: A Hunter's Boast
text: Kill 6 Mountain Buzzards and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 15 minutes.

258.name: A Hunter's Challenge
text: Kill 5 Elder Mountain Boars and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 12 minutes.

261.name: Down the Scarlet Path
text: Destroy 30 Undead Ravagers, then return to Brother Anton at Nijel's Point.

262.name: The Shadowy Figure
text: Take the book you found at Sven's farm and show it to townsfolk in Darkshire.

263.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
text: Mountaineer Wallbang in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.

264.name: Until Death Do Us Part
text: Place Clarice's Pendant on Yuriv's Tomb in Silverpine.

265.name: The Shadowy Search Continues
text: See if other townsfolk have clues about the shadowy figure.

266.name: Inquire at the Inn
text: Search the inn for clues about the shadowy figure.

267.name: The Trogg Threat
text: Bring 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.

268.name: Return to Sven
text: Return to Sven with Jitters' completed journal.

269.name: Seeking Wisdom
text: Give Jitters' Completed Journal to Bishop Farthing in Stormwind.

270.name: The Doomed Fleet
text: Go to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands, and speak with Glorin Steelbrow.

271.name: Vyrin's Revenge
text: Kill Ol' Sooty then show your handiwork to Daryl the Youngling at the Farstrider Lodge.

272.name: Trial of the Sea Lion
text: Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance. Speak with the residents of Moonglade to learn clues as to where these items may be located.
Form the Pendant of the Sea Lion from the two pendant halves. You need to be in proximity of the Shrine of Remulos to do this.
Bring the joined pendant to Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

273.name: Resupplying the Excavation
text: Speak with Huldar.

274.name: A Dark Threat Looms
text: Ashlan Stonesmirk wants you to return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and inform him of the new discovery.

275.name: Blisters on The Land
text: Kill 12 Fen Creepers, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.

276.name: Tramping Paws
text: Kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.

277.name: Fire Taboo
text: Bring Rethiel the Greenwarden 9 Crude Flints.

278.name: A Dark Threat Looms
text: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to gather Lurker Venom, a Mo'grosh Crystal, and a Crocolisk Tear.

279.name: Claws from the Deep
text: Kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs.
Slay Gobbler and take his head.
Bring Gobbler's Head to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.

280.name: A Dark Threat Looms
text: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to swim down to the base of the dam, locate the powder keg and stir in the Disarming Mixture to prevent an explosion.

281.name: Reclaiming Goods
text: Search the crates and barrels at the coastal Murloc camps.

282.name: Senir's Observations
text: Speak with Mountaineer Thalos.

283.name: A Dark Threat Looms
text: The Disarming Mixture seemed to take effect. Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir to report the good news.

284.name: The Search Continues
text: Search for the Menethil Statuette.

285.name: Search More Hovels
text: Continue searching the Murloc hovels for the Menethil Statuette.

286.name: Return the Statuette
text: Bring Karl Boran the Menethil Statuette.

287.name: Frostmane Hold
text: Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

288.name: The Third Fleet
text: Buy First Mate Fitzsimmons a Flagon of Mead.

289.name: The Cursed Crew
text: Kill 13 Cursed Sailors, 5 Cursed Marines and First Mate Snellig. Bring Snellig's Snuffbox to First Mate Fitzsimmons in Menethil Harbor.

290.name: Lifting the Curse
text: Get the Intrepid Strongbox Key from Captain Halyndor.
Use the key to open the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox.

291.name: The Reports
text: Deliver Senir's report to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge.

292.name: The Eye of Paleth
text: Bring the Cursed Eye of Paleth to Glorin Steelbrow.

293.name: Cleansing the Eye
text: Bring Archbishop Benedictus the Cursed Eye of Paleth. Benedictus is in the Cathedral of Light, in the city of Stormwind.

294.name: Ormer's Revenge
text: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill 10 Mottled Screechers and 10 Mottled Raptors.

295.name: Ormer's Revenge
text: Ormer Ironbraid wants you to kill 10 Mottled Scytheclaw raptors and 10 Mottled Razormaw raptors then return to him at the Whelgar Excavation Site.

296.name: Ormer's Revenge
text: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill Sarltooth and return to him with one of his talons once the task is fulfilled.

297.name: Gathering Idols
text: Bring Magmar Fellhew 8 Carved Stone Idols.

298.name: Excavation Progress Report
text: Bring Ironband's Progress Report to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.

299.name: Uncovering the Past
text: Prospector Whelgar wants you to scour the excavation site in search of the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru.

301.name: Report to Ironforge
text: Take Ironband's Progress Report to Prospector Stormpike.

302.name: Powder to Ironband
text: Speak with Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.

303.name: The Dark Iron War
text: Motley Garmason at Dun Modr wants you to kill 10 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Dark Iron Tunnelers, 5 Dark Iron Saboteurs and 5 Dark Iron Demolitionists.

304.name: A Grim Task
text: Kill Balgaras the Foul and bring his ear to Longbraid the Grim outside of Dun Modr.

305.name: In Search of The Excavation Team
text: Tarrel Rockweaver wants you to travel to the Excavation Site and contact Merrin Rockweaver.

306.name: In Search of The Excavation Team
text: Return to Tarrel Rockweaver with Merrin's note.

307.name: Filthy Paws
text: Go to the Silver Stream Mine and collect 4 loads of Miners' Gear.
Return to Mountaineer Stormpike.

309.name: Protecting the Shipment

explore.text: Escort Miran to the excavation site

text: Ensure Miran and the shipment arrive at the excavation site, then inform Prospector Ironband.

310.name: Bitter Rivals
text: In the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, replace a barrel of Thunder Ale with a Barrel of Barleybrew Scalder.

311.name: Return to Marleth
text: Bring the barrel of Thunder Ale to Marleth Barleybrew at the Brewnall Village.

312.name: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash
text: Retrieve Tundra MacGrann's dried meats from the stolen meat locker in Old Icebeard's cave.

313.name: The Grizzled Den
text: Gather 8 Wendigo Manes and bring them to Pilot Stonegear.

314.name: Protecting the Herd
text: Rudra Amberstill wants you to slay Vagash and bring his fang to her at the Ram ranch.

315.name: The Perfect Stout
text: Bring 6 Shimmerweeds to Rejold Barleybrew in the Brewnall Village.

317.name: Stocking Jetsteam
text: Gather 4 Chunks of Boar Meat and 2 Thick Bear Furs, and deliver them to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.

318.name: Evershine
text: Get a cask of Evershine from Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.

319.name: A Favor for Evershine
text: Kill 6 Ice Claw Bears, 8 Elder Crag Boars, and 8 Snow Leopards, and then return to Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.

320.name: Return to Bellowfiz
text: Give the cask of Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.

321.name: Lightforge Iron
text: Search the wreckage of The Flying Osprey in the Wetlands.

322.name: Blessed Arm
text: Take the Crate of Lightforge Ingots to Grimand Elmore in Stormwind.

323.name: Proving Your Worth
text: Kill 15 Skeletal Raiders, 3 Skeletal Healers and 3 Skeletal Warders, and then return to Sven.

324.name: The Lost Ingots
text: Gather 5 Lightforge Ingots, then return to Glorin Steelbrow in the Wetlands.

325.name: Armed and Ready
text: Bring Morbent's Bane to Sven in Duskwood.

328.name: The Hidden Key
text: Use the Small Brass Key to open Bookie Herod's Strongbox.

329.name: The Spy Revealed!
text: Take the Muddy Note to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

330.name: Patrol Schedules
text: Speak with Corporal Sethman.

331.name: Report to Doren
text: Speak with Lieutenant Doren.

332.name: Wine Shop Advert
text: Go to the Gallina Winery, and bring Suzetta Gallina the Wine Ticket for a free bottle of wine.

333.name: Harlan Needs a Resupply
text: Go to the Canal Tailor Shop and bring Rema Schneider the Cloth Request from Harlan Bagley.

334.name: Package for Thurman
text: Go to the Larson Clothiers in the Stormwind Mage Quarter, and give Thurman Schneider his Sewing Kit.

335.name: A Noble Brew
text: Zardeth the Black Claw wants you to bring him a Tear of Tilloa from Darkshire and a Musquash Root from the Wetlands.

336.name: A Noble Brew
text: Take the Black Claw Stout to Lord Wishock in the Hall of Petitioners.

337.name: An Old History Book
text: Return the book: The History of Stormwind, to the Stormwind Library.

338.name: The Green Hills of Stranglethorn
text: Collect the missing pages from The Green Hills of Stranglethorn manuscript. Once all four chapters are complete, return them to Barnil.

339.name: Chapter I
text: Bring pages 1, 4, 6, and 8 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter I.

340.name: Chapter II
text: Bring pages 10, 11, 14 and 16 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter II.

341.name: Chapter III
text: Bring pages 18, 20, 21and 24 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter III.

342.name: Chapter IV
text: Bring pages 25, 26, and 27 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter IV.

343.name: Speaking of Fortitude
text: Go to the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep and speak with Milton Sheaf. He can find for you the book on metallurgy that Brother Kristoff needs for his speech.

344.name: Brother Paxton
text: Speak with Brother Paxton in the Northshire Abbey.

345.name: Ink Supplies
text: Speak with Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire and ask him for Rethban Iron Ore.

346.name: Return to Kristoff
text: Return to Brother Kristoff in the Cathedral Square. Give him the book The Stresses of Iron.

347.name: Rethban Ore
text: Gather 5 loads of Rethban Ore and bring it to Brother Paxton in the Northshire Library.

348.name: Stranglethorn Fever
text: Seek out Witch Doctor Unbagwa and have him summon Mokk the Savage. Bring the Heart of Mokk to Fin Fizracket.

350.name: Look to an Old Friend
text: Speak to Elling Trias in Stormwind.

351.name: Find OOX-17/TN!
text: Bring the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot.

353.name: Stormpike's Delivery
text: Deliver the Package for Stormpike to Mountaineer Stormpike in Loch Modan.

354.name: Deaths in the Family
text: Bring Gregor's Remains, Nissa's Remains and Thurman's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.

355.name: Speak with Sevren
text: Speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

356.name: Rear Guard Patrol
text: Kill 8 Bleeding Horrors and 8 Wandering Spirits, then report back to Linnea at her camp.

357.name: The Lich's Identity
text: Bring the Lich's Spellbook to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

358.name: Graverobbers
text: Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels.
Bring 8 Embalming Ichors to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

359.name: Forsaken Duties
text: Speak with Deathguard Linnea.

360.name: Return to the Magistrate
text: Return to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

361.name: A Letter Undelivered
text: Find Yvette Farthing, and deliver to her the letter from Thurman Agamand.

362.name: The Haunted Mills
text: Slay Devlin Agamand, and bring Devlin's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.

363.name: Rude Awakening
text: Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis.

364.name: The Mindless Ones
text: Shadow Priest Sarvis wants you to kill 8 Mindless Zombies and 8 Wretched Zombies.

365.name: Fields of Grief
text: Steal 10 pumpkins from the farm to the west, just north of Deathknell and take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.

366.name: Return the Book
text: Return Gunther's Spellbook to him, on the island of Gunther's Retreat.

367.name: A New Plague
text: Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood.

368.name: A New Plague
text: Apothecary Johaan of the town of Brill needs 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in Tirisfal Glades.

369.name: A New Plague
text: Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to bring him 4 samples of venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider.

370.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
text: Executor Zygand in Brill wants you to kill Captain Perrine, 3 Scarlet Zealots and 3 Scarlet Missionaries.

371.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
text: Executor Zygand in Brill has commissioned you to slay Captain Vachon and 5 Scarlet Friars.

372.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
text: Executor Zygand in the town of Brill wants you to assassinate Captain Melrache and his two bodyguards.

373.name: The Unsent Letter
text: Deliver the Letter to the City Architect to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

374.name: Proof of Demise
text: Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.

375.name: The Chill of Death
text: Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread to Gretchen Dedmar in Brill.

376.name: The Damned
text: Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.

377.name: Crime and Punishment
text: Councilman Millstipe of Darkshire wants you to bring him the hand of Dextren Ward.

378.name: The Fury Runs Deep
text: Motley Garmason wants Kam Deepfury's head brought to him at Dun Modr.

379.name: Slake That Thirst
text: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

380.name: Night Web's Hollow
text: Executor Arren wants you to kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders and 8 Night Web Spiders.

381.name: The Scarlet Crusade
text: Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.

382.name: The Red Messenger
text: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, then return any information you find to Executor Arren.

383.name: Vital Intelligence
text: Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Executor Zygand in Brill.

384.name: Beer Basted Boar Ribs
text: Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos wants 6 Crag Boar Ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt.

385.name: Crocolisk Hunting
text: Get 5 pieces of Crocolisk Meat and 6 Crocolisk Skins for Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge.

386.name: What Comes Around...
text: Bring the head of Targorr the Dread to Guard Berton in Lakeshire.

387.name: Quell The Uprising
text: Warden Thelwater of Stormwind wants you to kill 10 Defias Prisoners, 8 Defias Convicts, and 8 Defias Insurgents in The Stockade.

388.name: The Color of Blood
text: Nikova Raskol of Stormwind wants you to collect 10 Red Wool Bandanas.

389.name: Bazil Thredd
text: Speak with Warden Thelwater in the Stockade.

391.name: The Stockade Riots
text: Kill Bazil Thredd and bring his head back to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade.

392.name: The Curious Visitor
text: Bring the Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

393.name: Shadow of the Past
text: Bring the Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

394.name: The Head of the Beast
text: Speak to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

395.name: Brotherhood's End
text: Speak with Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

396.name: An Audience with the King
text: Deliver Baros Alexston's report on the Defias Brotherhood to King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.

397.name: You Have Served Us Well
text: Speak with Zggi, the servant of Zardeth the Blackclaw, to claim your reward.

398.name: Wanted: Maggot Eye
text: Kill Maggot Eye and return to Executor Zygand in Brill with his paw for a reward.

399.name: Humble Beginnings
text: Go to Baros Alexston's house in Westfall and search for his compass, then return it to him in Cathedral Square of Stormwind.

400.name: Tools for Steelgrill
text: Deliver Steelgrill's Tools to Beldin Steelgrill.

401.name: Wait for Sirra to Finish
text: Wait a moment, then speak with Sirra Von'Indi again.

404.name: A Putrid Task
text: Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

405.name: The Prodigal Lich
text: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

407.name: Fields of Grief
text: Take the Laced Pumpkin to the Captured Scarlet Zealot who is being held in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.

408.name: The Family Crypt
text: Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors.
Kill Captain Dargol, and bring his skull to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

409.name: Proving Allegiance
text: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning.
Summon Lillith Nefara and kill her.
Return to Gunther on his island.

411.name: The Prodigal Lich Returns
text: Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

412.name: Operation Recombobulation
text: Bring Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos 8 Restabilization Cogs and 8 Gyromechanic Gears.

413.name: Shimmer Stout
text: Take the Barrel of Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Barleybrew.

414.name: Stout to Kadrell
text: Take the Cask of Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Kadrell.

415.name: Rejold's New Brew
text: Speak with Rejold Barleybrew.

416.name: Rat Catching
text: Bring 12 Tunnel Rat Ears to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar.

417.name: A Pilot's Revenge
text: Kill Mangeclaw.
Bring his Mangy Claw and Hildelve's Journal to Pilot Hammerfoot.

418.name: Thelsamar Blood Sausages
text: Bring 3 pieces of Bear Meat, 3 Boar Intestines, and 3 Spider Ichor to Vidra Hearthstove in Thelsamar.

419.name: The Lost Pilot
text: Find Pilot Hildelve.

420.name: Senir's Observations
text: Deliver Grelin's report to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

421.name: Prove Your Worth
text: Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher wants you to kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.

422.name: Arugal's Folly
text: Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal for Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

423.name: Arugal's Folly
text: Bring 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

424.name: Arugal's Folly
text: Kill Grimson the Pale and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

425.name: Ivar the Foul
text: Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.

426.name: The Mills Overrun
text: Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

427.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
text: Executor Zygand of Brill wants you to kill 10 Scarlet Warriors.

428.name: Lost Deathstalkers
text: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.

429.name: Wild Hearts
text: Gather 6 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

430.name: Return to Quinn
text: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.

432.name: Those Blasted Troggs!
text: Kill 6 Rockjaw Skullthumpers for Foreman Stonebrow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.

433.name: The Public Servant
text: Kill 10 Rockjaw Bonesnappers for Senator Mehr Stonehallow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.

434.name: The Attack!
text: Remain in the garden until Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade have had their conversation. Afterwards, kill them both before returning to Elling Trias in Stormwind.

435.name: Escorting Erland
text: Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.

436.name: Ironband's Excavation
text: Speak with Explorer Fellhew.

437.name: The Dead Fields
text: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields.
When Nightlash appears, kill her.
Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

438.name: The Decrepit Ferry
text: Go to the Decrepit Ferry.
Search for the reason the Scourge are there.

439.name: Rot Hide Clues
text: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

440.name: The Engraved Ring
text: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

441.name: Raleigh and the Undercity
text: Bring Deliah's Ring to Raleigh.

442.name: Assault on Fenris Isle
text: Bring Thule's Head to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

443.name: Rot Hide Ichor
text: Bring 8 bottles of rot hide ichor to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

444.name: Rot Hide Origins
text: Bring the Sample Ichor to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

445.name: Delivery to Silverpine Forest
text: Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.

446.name: Thule Ravenclaw
text: Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel at the Silverpine Sepulcher.

447.name: A Recipe For Death
text: Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 samples of Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

448.name: Report to Hadrec
text: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

449.name: The Deathstalkers' Report
text: Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

450.name: A Recipe For Death
text: Retrieve Apothecary Berard's journal from Pyrewood Village and take it to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

451.name: A Recipe For Death
text: Bring 6 samples of Lake Creeper Moss, 6 samples of Lake Skulker Moss and a Hardened Tumor to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

452.name: Pyrewood Ambush
text: Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.

453.name: Finding the Shadowy Figure
text: Find the Shadowy Figure. Your clues:
He is not native to Darkshire.
He is a nervous, jittery person.
He left Darkshire and headed west.

454.name: After the Ambush
text: Speak with Miran.

455.name: The Algaz Gauntlet
text: Traverse Dun Algaz.
Kill 8 Dragonmaw Scouts and 6 Dragonmaw Grunts.
Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.

456.name: The Balance of Nature
text: Kill 7 Young Nightsabers and 4 Young Thistle Boars and return to Conservator Ilthalaine.

457.name: The Balance of Nature
text: Conservator Ilthalaine needs you to kill 7 Mangy Nightsabers and 7 Thistle Boars.

458.name: The Woodland Protector
text: Seek out the dryad known as Tarindrella.

459.name: The Woodland Protector
text: Collect 8 Fel Moss and bring them to Tarindrella.

460.name: Resting in Pieces
text: Bring Alaric's Head to his grave.

461.name: The Hidden Niche
text: Take Alaric to the hidden alcove.

463.name: The Greenwarden
text: Find the Greenwarden.

464.name: War Banners
text: Bring 8 Dragonmaw War Banners to Captain Stoutfist.

465.name: Nek'rosh's Gambit
text: Destroy the Dragonmaw catapults.

466.name: Search for Incendicite
text: Bring 6 loads of Incendicite Ore to Pilot Stonegear in Dun Morogh.

467.name: Stonegear's Search
text: Speak with Pilot Stonegear.

468.name: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar
text: Speak with Mountaineer Rockgar.

469.name: Daily Delivery
text: Deliver the Bundle of Crocolisk Skins to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil Harbor.

470.name: Digging Through the Ooze
text: One of the oozes at Ironbeard's Tomb has Sida's bag, retrieve it and bring it back to her in Menethil Harbor.

471.name: Apprentice's Duties
text: Collect 6 Giant Crocolisk Skins and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.

472.name: Fall of Dun Modr
text: Search for Longbraid near the town of Dun Modr.

473.name: Report to Captain Stoutfist
text: Speak with Captain Stoutfist.

474.name: Defeat Nek'rosh
text: Kill Chieftain Nek'rosh
Bring Nek'rosh's Head to Captain Stoutfist.

475.name: A Troubling Breeze
text: Seek out Gaerolas Talvethren in Starbreeze Village.

476.name: Gnarlpine Corruption
text: Return to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.

477.name: Border Crossings
text: Retrieve the contents of one of the Dalaran wizards' crates. You will find Pyrewood Village to the south.

478.name: Maps and Runes
text: Bring the strange pendant to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

479.name: Ambermill Investigations

You will be rewarded for each Flawless Draenethyst Sphere you have collected.

3101.name: Consecrated Letter
text: Read the Consecrated Letter and speak to Brother Sammuel in Northshire Abbey.

3102.name: Encrypted Letter
text: Read the Encrypted Letter and speak to Jorik Kerridan in the stable behind Northshire Abbey.

3103.name: Hallowed Letter
text: Read the Hallowed Letter and speak to Priestess Anetta in Northshire Abbey.

3104.name: Glyphic Letter
text: Read the Glyphic Letter and speak to Khelden Bremen inside Northshire Abbey.

3105.name: Tainted Letter
text: Read the Tainted Letter and speak to Drusilla La Salle next to Northshire Abbey.

3106.name: Simple Rune
text: Read the Simple Rune and speak to Thran Khorman in Coldridge Valley.

3107.name: Consecrated Rune
text: Read the Consecrated Rune and speak to Bromos Grummner in Coldridge Valley.

3108.name: Etched Rune
text: Read the Etched Rune and speak to Thorgas Grimson in Coldridge Valley.

3109.name: Encrypted Rune
text: Read the Encrypted Rune and speak to Solm Hargrin in Coldridge Valley.

3110.name: Hallowed Rune
text: Read the Hallowed Rune and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.

3112.name: Simple Memorandum
text: Read the Simple Memorandum and speak to Thran Khorman in Coldridge Valley.

3113.name: Encrypted Memorandum
text: Read the Encrypted Memorandum and speak to Solm Hargrin in Coldridge Valley.

3114.name: Glyphic Memorandum
text: Read the Glyphic Memorandum and speak to Marryk Nurribit inside Anvilmar above Coldridge Valley.

3115.name: Tainted Memorandum
text: Read the Tainted Memorandum and speak to Alamar Grimm inside Anvilmar above Coldridge Valley.

3116.name: Simple Sigil
text: Read the Simple Sigil and speak to Alyissia in Shadowglen.

3117.name: Etched Sigil
text: Read the Etched Sigil and speak to Ayanna Everstride at the top of Aldrassil in Shadowglen.

3118.name: Encrypted Sigil
text: Read the Encrypted Sigil and speak to Frahun Shadewhisper in Shadowglen.

3119.name: Hallowed Sigil
text: Read the Hallowed Sigil and speak to Shanda in Aldrassil.

3120.name: Verdant Sigil
text: Read the Verdant Sigil and speak to Mardant Strongoak, in the tree Aldrassil in Shadowglen.

3121.name: A Strange Request
text: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

3122.name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
text: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

3123.name: Testing the Vessel
text: Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin. Kill 10, and use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Wildkin.
Bring 10 Wildkin Muiseks and the Muisek Vessel to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

3124.name: Hippogryph Muisek
text: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.

3125.name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
text: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Faerie Dragons.

3126.name: Treant Muisek
text: Kill 3 Wandering Forest Walkers. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Treants.

3127.name: Mountain Giant Muisek
text: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.

3128.name: Natural Materials
text: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.

3129.name: Weapons of Spirit
text: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.

3130.name: Against the Hatecrest
text: Report to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.

3141.name: Loramus
text: Listen to Loramus Thalipedes tell his story.

3161.name: Gahz'ridian
text: Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.

3181.name: The Horn of the Beast
text: Take Margol's Gigantic Horn to Mountaineer Pebblebitty.

3182.name: Proof of Deed
text: Take Margol's Gigantic Horn to Curator Thorius in Ironforge.

3201.name: At Last!
text: Take the Proof of Deed back to Mountaineer Pebblebitty.

3221.name: Speak with Renferrel
text: Speak with Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

3261.name: Jorn Skyseer
text: Speak with Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

3281.name: Stolen Silver
text: Bring the Stolen Silver to Gazrog in the Crossroads.

3301.name: Mura Runetotem
text: Speak with Mura Runetotem in the Sepulcher.

3321.name: Did You Lose This?
text: Wait for Trenton to finish his work.

3341.name: Bring the End
text: Andrew Brownell wants you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.

3361.name: A Refugee's Quandary
text: Bring Felix's Box, Felix's Chest and Felix's Bucket of Bolts to Felix Whindlebolt in Anvilmar.

3362.name: Thistleshrub Valley
text: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.

3364.name: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery
text: Take a Scalding Mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar before it gets cold in five minutes!

3365.name: Bring Back the Mug
text: Return Nori's Mug to Nori Pridedrift.

3367.name: Suntara Stones
text: Help Dorius get back to Ironforge.

3368.name: Suntara Stones
text: Take the Singed Letter to Thorius in Ironforge. He is in the Hall of Explorers.

3369.name: In Nightmares
text: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise.

3370.name: In Nightmares
text: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.

3371.name: Dwarven Justice
text: Return to the Searing Gorge and find Dorius's archaeology unit.

3372.name: Release Them
text: Find the Mysterious Artifact being guarded by the Twilight's Hammer Idolaters in the northwest quadrant of the Searing Gorge and bring it to the Altar of Suntara in the Slag Pit.

3373.name: The Essence of Eranikus
text: Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font located in this lair in the Sunken Temple.

3374.name: The Essence of Eranikus
text: Bring the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight and the Chained Essence of Eranikus to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows. It is there that you will make your choice to aid Ysera's Dragonflight or not.

3375.name: Replacement Phial
text: Bring a Mana Potion, Coal, and Sweet Nectar to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge to get a replacement for Talvash's Phial of Scrying.

3376.name: Break Sharptusk!
text: Bring the head of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle to Brave Windfeather in Red Cloud Mesa.

3377.name: Prayer to Elune
text: Hear Zamael tell his tale.

3378.name: Prayer to Elune
text: Find the Prayer to Elune and take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus.

3379.name: Shadoweaver
text: Kill the group of Shadow Silk Poachers that wander the Searing Gorge. Nilith has reason to believe that there are five of them that need to be exterminated. Return to Nilith in the Searing Gorge when this task is complete.

3380.name: The Sunken Temple
text: Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.

3382.name: A Crew Under Fire

explore.text: Protect Captain Vanessa Beltis from the naga attack

text: Defend Captain Vanessa Beltis, her crew and the Horizon Scout's passengers against the naga attack. Captain Vanessa Beltis must survive.

3385.name: The Undermarket
text: Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Retrieve the Trader's Satchel from his corpse and return it to Nilith.

3402.name: The Undermarket
text: Speak with Vizzklick in Gadgetzan.

3441.name: Divine Retribution
text: Listen as Kalaran Windblade tells his story.

3442.name: The Flawless Flame
text: Collect 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of Golem Oil and return the items to Kalaran Windblade.

3443.name: Forging the Shaft
text: Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.

3444.name: The Stone Circle
text: Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

3445.name: The Sunken Temple
text: Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.

3446.name: Into the Depths
text: Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in Swamp of Sorrows.

3447.name: Secret of the Circle
text: Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.

3448.name: Passing the Burden
text: Speak to Tymor in Ironforge.

3449.name: Arcane Runes
text: Using the Drawing Kit, make rubbings of the Rune of Beth'Amara, the Rune of Jin'yael, the Rune of Markri, and the Rune of Sael'hai before heading to the small island off of the southern peninsula of Azshara and signaling Pilot Xiggs Fuselighter to pick them up.

3450.name: An Easy Pickup
text: Speak to Xiggs Fuselighter in Ironforge.

3451.name: Signal for Pickup
text: Speak to Xiggs Fuselighter and get a Standard Issue Flare Gun from him in Ironforge.

3452.name: The Flame's Casing
text: Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.

3453.name: The Torch of Retribution
text: Wait for Kalaran Windblade to complete the Torch of Retribution.

3454.name: The Torch of Retribution
text: Take the Torch of Retribution.

3461.name: Return to Tymor
text: Return Tymor's Drawing Kit to him in Ironforge.

3462.name: Squire Maltrake
text: Speak with Squire Maltrake.

3463.name: Set Them Ablaze!
text: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.

3481.name: Trinkets...
text: Open the chest.

3501.name: Everything Counts In Large Amounts
text: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.

3502.name: One Draenei's Junk...
text: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the Blasted Lands could be carrying a fragment.

3504.name: Betrayed
text: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.

3505.name: Betrayed
text: Kill 10 Blood Elf Reclaimers, and 10 Blood Elf Surveyors before seeking out Magus Rimtori's camp. Once you've found it, look for something that might be important to her that can be used to draw her into a fight.

3506.name: Betrayed
text: Destroy the arcane focusing crystal tied to Magus Rimtori and then slay her. Afterwards, take the Head of Magus Rimtori to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.

3507.name: Betrayed
text: Speak to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

3508.name: Breaking the Ward
text: Wait for Loramus to complete the enlightenment spell.

3509.name: The Name of the Beast
text: Speak with Lord Arkkoroc in Azshara. Begin your search at the waters edge to find the Temple of Arkkoran.

3510.name: The Name of the Beast
text: Slay Hetaera and bring back Hetaera's Bloodied Head, Hetaera's Beaten Head, and Hetaera's Bruised Head to Lord Arkkoroc.

3511.name: The Name of the Beast
text: Take the temper back to Loramus Thalipedes.

3512.name: In Eranikus' Own Words
text: Travel to the eastern part of Winterspring and speak with Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.

3513.name: The Runed Scroll
text: Take the Runed Scroll to the northern guard tower in the Barrens.

3514.name: Horde Presence
text: Kill the leader of the Talon Den, Rynthariel the Keymaster.

3517.name: Stealing Knowledge
text: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.

3518.name: Delivery to Magatha
text: Bring the Tablet of Beth'Amara to Magatha in Thunder Bluff.

3519.name: A Friend in Need
text: Speak to Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen.

3520.name: Screecher Spirits
text: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.
extraObjectives: Slay Vale Screechers and use Yeh'kinya's Bramble on their corpse.

3521.name: Iverron's Antidote
text: Collect 7 Hyacinth Mushrooms, 4 Moonpetal Lilies, and 1 Webwood Ichor for Dirania Silveshine in Shadowglen.

3522.name: Iverron's Antidote
text: Bring Iverron's Antidote to Iverron before the time limit is up. Iverron can be found by the cave to the north.

3523.name: Scourge of the Downs
text: If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.

3524.name: Washed Ashore
text: Recover Sea Creature Bones from the beached sea creature just south of Auberdine, and then return with it to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

3525.name: Extinguishing the Idol

explore.text: Protect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol

text: Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs.
Protect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.

3526.name: Goblin Engineering
text: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3527.name: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru
text: Bring the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

3528.name: The God Hakkar
text: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

3541.name: Delivery to Jes'rimon
text: Bring the Tablet of Jin'yael to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.

3542.name: Delivery to Andron Gant
text: Bring the Tablet of Markri to Andron Gant in Undercity.

3561.name: Delivery to Archmage Xylem
text: Bring the Tablet of Sael'hai to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.

3562.name: Magatha's Payment to Jediga
text: Deliver Magatha's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3563.name: Jes'rimon's Payment to Jediga
text: Deliver Jes'rimon's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3564.name: Andron's Payment to Jediga
text: Deliver Andron's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3565.name: Xylem's Payment to Jediga
text: Deliver Xylem's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3566.name: Rise, Obsidion!
text: Slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion, and return to Thorius in Ironforge with the Head of Lathoric the Black and the Heart of Obsidion.

3568.name: Seeping Corruption
text: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.

3569.name: Seeping Corruption
text: Give Cuely's Elixir to Thersa Windsong in Undercity.

3601.name: Kim'jael Indeed!
text: Search the Thalassian Base Camp for Kim'jael's Compass, Scope, Stuffed Chicken and Wizzlegoober, then return them to him in Azshara.

3602.name: Azsharite
text: Recover twenty Crystallized Azsharite from southern Azshara. You may use the Felhound to assist you in 'sniffing' out the location of cleverly hidden deposits.
Return to Loramus when the task is complete.

3621.name: The Formation of Felbane
text: Take the Shipment to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn Vale.

3625.name: Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry
text: Wait for Galvan to finish forging the weaponry.

3626.name: Return to the Blasted Lands
text: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

3627.name: Uniting the Shattered Amulet
text: Slay Grol the Destroyer, Lady Sevine, and Archmage Allistarj. From their corpses take the Amulet of Grol, the Amulet of Sevine, and the Amulet of Allistarj.
Remember to USE your Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry to weaken the triad. They cannot be killed otherwise - but use them wisely...

3628.name: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
text: Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.
extraObjectives: Teleport to the top of the mountain.
Use the Ward of the Defiler to summon Razelikh.

3629.name: Goblin Engineering
text: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3630.name: Gnome Engineering
text: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

3631.name: Summon Felsteed
text: Speak to Strahad Farsan in the Barrens.

3632.name: Gnome Engineering
text: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

3633.name: Goblin Engineering
text: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3634.name: Gnome Engineering
text: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

3635.name: Gnome Engineering
text: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

3636.name: Bring the Light
text: Archbishop Bendictus wants you to slay Amnennar the Coldbringer in Razorfen Downs.

3637.name: Gnome Engineering
text: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

3638.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
text: If you agree to become a Goblin Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3639.name: Show Your Work
text: Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3640.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
text: If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

3641.name: Show Your Work
text: Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and 2 Advanced Target Dummies to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

3642.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
text: If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Oglethrope Obnoticus in Booty bay.

3643.name: Show Your Work
text: Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and a 2 Advanced Target Dummies to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

3661.name: Favored of Elune?
text: Collect 15 Wildkin Feathers from the Hinterlands for Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

3681.name: Tome of Divinity
text: Speak with Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

3701.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
text: Venture to the Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes and recover information from the Thaurissan Relics. Return to Royal Historian Archesonus when you have recovered the information.

3702.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
text: Listen to Royal Historian Archesonus recant the history of Thaurissan.

3741.name: Hilary's Necklace
text: Find Hilary's Necklace, and return it to Hilary in Lakeshire.

3761.name: Un'Goro Soil
text: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Ghede on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

3762.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
text: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3763.name: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm
text: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

3764.name: Un'Goro Soil
text: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Jenal at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.

3765.name: The Corruption Abroad
text: Travel to Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine.

3781.name: Morrowgrain Research
text: Take the Arch Druid's Seed Voucher to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.

3782.name: Morrowgrain Research
text: Take the Seed Voucher to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3783.name: Are We There, Yeti?
text: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.

3784.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
text: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3785.name: Morrowgrain Research
text: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.
Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.

3786.name: Morrowgrain Research
text: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.
Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3787.name: Jonespyre's Request
text: Speak with Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

3788.name: Jonespyre's Request
text: Speak with Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

3789.name: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm
text: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

3790.name: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm
text: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

3791.name: The Mystery of Morrowgrain
text: Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

3801.name: Dark Iron Legacy
text: Speak with Franclorn Forgewright if you are interested in obtaining a key to the city major.

3802.name: Dark Iron Legacy
text: Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright.

3821.name: Dreadmaul Rock
text: Venture forth to the Burning Steppes and find out what became of Sha'ni Proudtusk.

3822.name: Krom'Grul
text: Recover Sha'ni's Nose-Ring from Krom'Grul and return it to Thal'trak in Kargath. Search the various caves and mines in Dreadmaul Rock.

3823.name: Extinguish the Firegut
text: Slay 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres, and 7 Firegut Ogre Brutes, and return to Oralius when you are finished.

3824.name: Gor'tesh the Brute Lord
text: Find Gor'tesh, somewhere to the west of Dreadmaul Rock. Kill Gor'tesh and then take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head back to Oralius in Burning Steppes.

3825.name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
text: Take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head and place it at the top of Dreadmaul Rock. Look for a soft dirt mound to plant the pike.

3841.name: An Orphan Looking For a Home
text: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

3842.name: A Short Incubation
text: Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

3843.name: The Newest Member of the Family
text: Take your Fragile Sprite Darter Egg to the Hinterlands and speak to Agnar Beastamer, but hurry, you only have 1 hour to find him before the hatchling within the egg dies.

3844.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
text: Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.

3845.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
text: Examine the items inside the pack and bring them to their owner.

3861.name: CLUCK!
text: Find some Special Chicken Feed and return to your befriended chicken. When you find it, /cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed.

3881.name: Expedition Salvation
text: Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

3882.name: Roll the Bones
text: Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.

3883.name: Alien Ecology
text: Use the Scraping Vial to collect a Hive Wall Sample from one of the Gorishi hive hatcheries in Un'Goro Crater. Look for the chambers with the hanging larval spawns.
Bring the Hive Wall Sample to Hol'anyee Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

3884.name: Williden's Journal
text: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.

3901.name: Rattling the Rattlecages
text: Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.

3902.name: Scavenging Deathknell
text: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.

3903.name: Milly Osworth
text: Speak with Milly Osworth.

3904.name: Milly's Harvest
text: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.

3905.name: Grape Manifest
text: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.

3906.name: Disharmony of Flame
text: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

3907.name: Disharmony of Fire
text: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.

3908.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
text: Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

3909.name: The Videre Elixir
text: Seek out Gregan Brewspewer in northern Feralas. From him, learn how you may acquire the Videre Elixir, then return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
extraObjectives: Place the Bait in front of Miblon Snarltooth.

3912.name: Meet at the Grave
text: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find Gaeriyan.

3913.name: A Grave Situation
text: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.

3914.name: Linken's Sword
text: Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.

3921.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
text: Bring the Broken Samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket.

3922.name: Nugget Slugs
text: Bring 15 Nugget Slugs to Wenikee Boltbucket in the Barrens.

3923.name: Rilli Greasygob
text: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

3924.name: Samophlange Manual
text: Bring the Samophlange Manual to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

3941.name: A Gnome's Assistance
text: Find J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal's Refuge.

3942.name: Linken's Memory
text: Find Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

3961.name: Linken's Adventure
text: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.

3962.name: It's Dangerous to Go Alone
text: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.
Find Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.

3981.name: Commander Gor'shak
text: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths.
You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.

3982.name: What Is Going On?
text: Defend Gor'shak.

4001.name: What Is Going On?
text: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
You recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.

4002.name: The Eastern Kingdom
text: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

4003.name: The Royal Rescue
text: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.

4004.name: The Princess Saved?
text: Return to Thrall!

4005.name: Aquementas
text: Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris.
Use the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas.
After you have the completed totem, take it to J.D. Collie in Marshal's Refuge.

4021.name: Counterattack!
text: Bring a Piece of Krom'zar's Banner to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
extraObjectives: Hold off Kolkar invaders until Warlord Krom'zar spawns and then loot the banner spawned on his corpse.

4022.name: A Taste of Flame
text: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.

4023.name: A Taste of Flame
text: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.
You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

4024.name: A Taste of Flame
text: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.
You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.
extraObjectives: Use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'gar's corpse.

4061.name: The Rise of the Machines
text: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.
You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.

4062.name: The Rise of the Machines
text: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus.
You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

4063.name: The Rise of the Machines
text: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

4081.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
text: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.

4082.name: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
text: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.

4084.name: Silver Heart
text: Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.

4101.name: Cleansing Felwood
text: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Arathandris Silversky in Felwood.

4102.name: Cleansing Felwood
text: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in Felwood.

4120.name: The Strength of Corruption
text: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.

4121.name: Precarious Predicament
text: Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge.
You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

4122.name: Grark Lorkrub
text: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.

When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.

4123.name: The Heart of the Mountain
text: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

4124.name: The Missing Courier
text: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4125.name: The Missing Courier
text: Locate the courier's boat somewhere along the coast of Feralas.

4126.name: Hurley Blackbreath
text: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.

4127.name: Boat Wreckage
text: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold and show Ginro Hearthkindle the Discarded Knife you have found.

4128.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
text: Speak with Ragnar Thunderbrew.

4129.name: The Knife Revealed
text: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4130.name: Psychometric Reading
text: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4131.name: The Woodpaw Gnolls
text: Search the Woodpaw Gnoll camps of southern Feralas for evidence of the courier's belongings or the courier himself.

4132.name: Operation: Death to Angerforge
text: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.

4133.name: Vivian Lagrave
text: Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4134.name: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe
text: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4135.name: The Writhing Deep
text: Now that Raschal's last known whereabouts have been discovered, continue your search for him or his remains in the Writhing Deep. According to the note, it is located to the south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.

4136.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
text: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

4141.name: Muigin and Larion
text: Collect 15 Bloodpetals and return to Muigin.

4142.name: A Visit to Gregan
text: Take a Bloodpetal to Gregan Brewspewer in Feralas.

4143.name: Haze of Evil
text: Collect 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze, then return to Muigin in Un'Goro Crater.

4145.name: Larion and Muigin
text: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.

4146.name: Zapper Fuel
text: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.

4147.name: Marvon's Workshop
text: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

4161.name: Recipe of the Kaldorei
text: Collect 7 Small Spider Legs for Zarrin in Dolanaar.

4181.name: Goblin Engineering
text: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

4182.name: Dragonkin Menace
text: Slay 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, 4 Black Wyrmkin and 1 Black Drake. Return to Helendis Riverhorn when the task is complete.

4183.name: The True Masters
text: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.

4184.name: The True Masters
text: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.
Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.

4185.name: The True Masters
text: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.

4186.name: The True Masters
text: Take Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

4201.name: The Love Potion
text: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.

4223.name: The True Masters
text: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

4224.name: The True Masters
text: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task.
You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.

4241.name: Marshal Windsor
text: Travel to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor.
You recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.

4242.name: Abandoned Hope
text: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.

4243.name: Chasing A-Me 01
text: Find A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

4244.name: Chasing A-Me 01
text: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

4245.name: Chasing A-Me 01

explore.text: Protect A-Me 01 until you reach Karna Remtravel

text: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel in Un'Goro Crater.

4261.name: Ancient Spirit
text: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.

4262.name: Overmaster Pyron
text: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig.
You recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?

4263.name: Incendius!
text: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!

4264.name: A Crumpled Up Note
text: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.

4265.name: Freed from the Hive
text: Free Raschal from the Zukk'ash hive.
Return to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold and let him know that Raschal is alive and well.

4266.name: A Hero's Welcome
text: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4267.name: Rise of the Silithid
text: Bring Raschal's Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

4281.name: Thalanaar Delivery
text: Bring the Undelivered Parcel to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.

4282.name: A Shred of Hope
text: Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information.
Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.

4283.name: FIFTY! YEP!
text: Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.

4284.name: Crystals of Power
text: Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge.

4285.name: The Northern Pylon
text: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

4286.name: The Good Stuff
text: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.

4287.name: The Eastern Pylon
text: Discover the location of the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

4288.name: The Western Pylon
text: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.

4289.name: The Apes of Un'Goro
text: Bring 2 Un'Goro Gorilla Pelts, 2 Un'Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un'Goro Thunderer Pelts to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

4290.name: The Fare of Lar'korwi
text: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.

4291.name: The Scent of Lar'korwi
text: Bring 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

4292.name: The Bait for Lar'korwi
text: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

4293.name: A Sample of Slime...
text: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

4294.name: ... and a Batch of Ooze
text: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

4296.name: Tablet of the Seven
text: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

4297.name: Food for Baby
text: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.

4298.name: Becoming a Parent
text: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.

4300.name: Bone-Bladed Weapons
text: Bring 8 White Ravasaur Claws to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.

4301.name: The Mighty U'cha
text: Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

4321.name: Making Sense of It
text: Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.

4322.name: Jail Break!
text: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.

4324.name: Yuka Screwspigot
text: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

4341.name: Kharan Mighthammer
text: Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer.
The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.

4342.name: Kharan's Tale
text: Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.

4361.name: The Bearer of Bad News
text: Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.

4362.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
text: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

4363.name: The Princess's Surprise
text: Return to Ironforge and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.

4402.name: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise
text: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.

4421.name: The Corruption of the Jadefire
text: Kill 11 Jadefire Felsworns, 9 Jadefire Shadowstalkers, 9 Jadefire Rogues, and Xavathras. Return to Eridan Bluewind in Felwood when the task has been completed.

4441.name: Felbound Ancients
text: Travel to Darnassus and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon. Return to Eridan with the filled vial.

4442.name: Purified!
text: Speak to Eridan again in a moment.

4449.name: Caught!
text: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge.

4450.name: Ledger from Tanaris
text: Take the copy of Goodsteel's Ledger and then find the items listed in it before seeking Krinkle Goodsteel in Tanaris.

4451.name: The Key to Freedom
text: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.

4485.name: The Tome of Nobility
text: Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

4486.name: The Tome of Nobility
text: Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

4487.name: Summon Felsteed
text: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

4488.name: Summon Felsteed
text: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

4489.name: Summon Felsteed
text: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

4490.name: Summon Felsteed
text: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet to learn the ability to summon a Felsteed.

4491.name: A Little Help From My Friends

explore.text: Escort Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge

text: Lead Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
If Ringo faints, use Spraggle's Canteen to revive him.

4492.name: Lost!

explore.text: Escort Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge

text: Find Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.

4493.name: March of the Silithid
text: Speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

4494.name: March of the Silithid
text: Speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

4495.name: A Good Friend
text: Find Iverron by the cave to the north.

4496.name: Bungle in the Jungle
text: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

4501.name: Beware of Pterrordax
text: Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.

4502.name: Volcanic Activity
text: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.

4503.name: Shizzle's Flyer
text: Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.

4504.name: Super Sticky
text: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

4505.name: Well of Corruption
text: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

4506.name: Corrupted Sabers

explore.text: Return the corrupted cat to Winna Hazzard

text: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moonwell, release it, then bring it back to Winna.
Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.
extraObjectives: Release the kitten near the Jadefire Satyrs' corrupted moonwell.

4507.name: Pawn Captures Queen
text: Defeat the Gorishi Hive Queen once she is summoned.
Bring the Gorishi Queen's Brain to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

4508.name: Calm Before the Storm
text: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

4509.name: Calm Before the Storm
text: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.

4510.name: Calm Before the Storm
text: Bring the Bank Voucher to Idriana in the bank of Darnassus.

4511.name: Calm Before the Storm
text: Bring the Bank Voucher to Karus in the bank of Orgrimmar.

4512.name: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
text: Bring 6 Filled Cursed Ooze Jars and 6 Filled Tainted Ooze Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.

4513.name: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
text: Bring 10 Filled Pure Sample Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.
If you have trouble finding them, perhaps try to get more clues from Laris.

4521.name: Wild Guardians
text: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.

4542.name: Message to Freewind Post
text: Bring the Urgent Message to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post.

4581.name: Kayneth Stillwind
text: Take Shindrell's Note to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.

4601.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
text: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

4602.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
text: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

4621.name: Avast Ye, Admiral!
text: Slay Fleet Master Seahorn and Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay, and then return to Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Veil off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

4641.name: Your Place In The World
text: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

4642.name: Melding of Influences
text: Bring a Merged Ooze Sample to Chemist Fuely in Undercity.

4681.name: Washed Ashore
text: Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.

4701.name: Put Her Down
text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy the source of the worg menace. As you left Helendis, he shouted a name: Halycon. It is what the orcs refer to in regards to the worg.

4721.name: Wild Guardians
text: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.

4722.name: Beached Sea Turtle
text: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4723.name: Beached Sea Creature
text: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4724.name: The Pack Mistress
text: Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.

4725.name: Beached Sea Turtle
text: Take the Strangely Marked Box to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4726.name: Broodling Essence
text: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
extraObjectives: Use the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 and defeat the dragonkin.

4727.name: Beached Sea Turtle
text: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4728.name: Beached Sea Creature
text: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4729.name: Kibler's Exotic Pets
text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.
extraObjectives: Use the Empty Worg Pup Cage to capture it.

4730.name: Beached Sea Creature
text: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4731.name: Beached Sea Turtle
text: Take the Strangely Marked Box to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4732.name: Beached Sea Turtle
text: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4733.name: Beached Sea Creature
text: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4734.name: Egg Freezing
text: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.

4735.name: Egg Collection
text: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

4736.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
text: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4737.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
text: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4738.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
text: Speak with Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4739.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
text: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4740.name: WANTED: Murkdeep!
text: Find and slay the murloc known as Murkdeep. The creature is thought to be defending the murloc huts south of Auberdine along the water.
Report the death of Murkdeep to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

4741.name: Wild Guardians
text: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.

4742.name: Seal of Ascension
text: Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan.
The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.

4743.name: Seal of Ascension
text: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.

It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension!
extraObjectives: Beat Emberstrife till his will is broken, then place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before him and use the Orb of Draconic Energy.
Use the Flames of the Black Flight over it to create the Seal.

4761.name: Thundris Windweaver
text: Speak with Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

4762.name: The Cliffspring River
text: Travel north of Auberdine to the first waterfall along the Cliffspring River and draw a sample from the pool there.
Return to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine with the Cliffspring River Sample.

4763.name: The Blackwood Corrupted
text: Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell.
Gather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps.
Mix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor.
Take the Talisman of Corruption and bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.
extraObjectives: Summon Xabraxxis once you have the required items from the Blackwood Stores.

4764.name: Doomrigger's Clasp
text: Bring Doomrigger's Clasp to Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

4765.name: Delivery to Ridgewell
text: Bring Ridgewell's Crate to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.

4766.name: Mayara Brightwing
text: Speak with Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

4767.name: Wind Rider
text: Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.

4768.name: The Darkstone Tablet
text: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4769.name: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
text: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.

4770.name: Homeward Bound
text: Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.

4771.name: Dawn's Gambit
text: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.

4781.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
text: Bring a Gold Bar to Xizk Goodstitch in Stranglethorn Vale.

4782.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
text: Return to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4783.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
text: Bring 10 Vials of Hatefury Blood and 1 Lesser Infernal Stone to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4784.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
text: Bring some Fine Gold Thread, 2 Smoldering Coals, and a Soul Shard to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4786.name: The Completed Robe
text: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your robe and then speak to her again.

4787.name: The Ancient Egg
text: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

4788.name: The Final Tablets
text: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

4808.name: Felnok Steelspring
text: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

4809.name: Chillwind Horns
text: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

4810.name: Return to Tinkee
text: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

4811.name: The Red Crystal

explore.text: Locate the large, red crystal on Darkshore's eastern mountain range

text: Travel east of Auberdine and look for a large, red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range. Report back what you find to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

4812.name: As Water Cascades
text: Fill the Empty Water Tube at the Auberdine moonwell, and then investigate the red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain wall.

4813.name: The Fragments Within
text: Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

4821.name: Alien Egg
text: Return the Alien Egg to Hagar Lightninghoof in Freewind Post.

4822.name: You Scream, I Scream...
text: Get some Strawberry Ice Cream for your ward. The lad seems to prefer Tigule's brand ice cream.

4841.name: Pacify the Centaur
text: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

4842.name: Strange Sources
text: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.

4861.name: Enraged Wildkin
text: Locate Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked camp and supplies in southern Winterspring.

4862.name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler.
By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.

4863.name: Enraged Wildkin
text: Find Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked wagon.

4864.name: Enraged Wildkin
text: Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of.
Bring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.

4865.name: Serpent Wild
text: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.

4866.name: Mother's Milk
text: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.

4867.name: Urok Doomhowl
text: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.
extraObjectives: Combine Omokk's Head with the Roughshod Pike.
Use it to instantly kill one nearby ogre.

4881.name: Assassination Plot
text: Warn Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post of the plot to kill him.

4882.name: Guarding Secrets
text: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.

4883.name: Guarding Secrets
text: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.

4901.name: Guardians of the Altar

explore.text: Discover the secret of the Altar of Elune

text: Protect Ranshalla while she attempts to reactivate the Altar of Elune. Report your findings to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
extraObjectives: Use it when Ranshalla tells you to

4902.name: Wildkin of Elune
text: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

4903.name: Warlord's Command
text: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.

4904.name: Free at Last

explore.text: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle.

text: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.

4906.name: Further Corruption
text: Eridan Bluewind in Felwood wants you to kill 8 Jadefire Hellcallers, 8 Jadefire Betrayers, 8 Jadefire Tricksters, and Xavaric. Return to Eridan when the task is completed.

4907.name: Tinkee Steamboil
text: Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.

4921.name: Lost in Battle
text: Find Mankrik's wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.

4941.name: Eitrigg's Wisdom
