text: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall.
You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.

4961.name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
text: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

4962.name: Shard of a Felhound
text: Take the Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4963.name: Shard of an Infernal
text: Take the Infus Emerald and use it on one of the Infernals found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Infus Emerald and the Imprisoned Infernal Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4964.name: The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil
text: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.

4965.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
text: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4966.name: Protect Kanati Greycloud
text: Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.

4967.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
text: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4968.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
text: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4969.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
text: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4970.name: Frostsaber Provisions
text: Collect 5 Shardtooth Meats and 5 Chillwind Meats for Rivern Frostwind in Winterspring.

4971.name: A Matter of Time
text: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.
Slay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4972.name: Counting Out Time
text: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4973.name: Counting Out Time
text: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches amongst the rubble of the city, and return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4974.name: For The Horde!
text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

4975.name: The Completed Orb of Noh'Orahil
text: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.

4976.name: Returning the Cleansed Orb
text: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4981.name: Operative Bijou
text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

4982.name: Bijou's Belongings
text: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.

4983.name: Bijou's Reconnaissance Report
text: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.

4984.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
text: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4985.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
text: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4986.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
text: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

4987.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
text: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

5001.name: Bijou's Belongings
text: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!

5002.name: Message to Maxwell
text: Travel to the Burning Steppes and give Bijou's Information to Marshal Maxwell.

5021.name: Better Late Than Never
text: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered. She claimed that it was where her horse was. As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.

5022.name: Better Late Than Never
text: Check with the Royal Factors of Stormwind to learn the whereabouts of an Emma Felstone. There is usually a census officer located in City Hall.

5023.name: Better Late Than Never
text: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.

5041.name: Supplies for the Crossroads
text: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.

5047.name: Pip Quickwit, At Your Service!
text: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.

5048.name: Good Natured Emma
text: Find Ol' Emma in Stormwind and see if she is in fact Emma Felstone. If she is, then perhaps she'd like the package Janice Felstone made for her.

5049.name: The Jeremiah Blues
text: Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone. If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.

5050.name: Good Luck Charm
text: Return to Janice Felstone in Western Plaguelands her Good Luck Half-Charm.

5051.name: Two Halves Become One
text: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it.
Give the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.

5052.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
text: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

5054.name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
text: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

5055.name: Brumeran of the Chillwind
text: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

5056.name: Shy-Rotam
text: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

5061.name: Aquatic Form
text: Return to Darnassus and show Mathrengyl Bearwalker the Pendant of the Sea Lion.

5062.name: Sacred Fire
text: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.

5063.name: Cap of the Scarlet Savant
text: In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5064.name: Grimtotem Spying
text: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

5065.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
text: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

5066.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
text: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5067.name: Leggings of Arcana
text: In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5068.name: Breastplate of Bloodthirst
text: In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5081.name: Maxwell's Mission
text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

5082.name: Threat of the Winterfall
text: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.

5083.name: Winterfall Firewater
text: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5084.name: Falling to Corruption
text: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

5085.name: Mystery Goo
text: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

5086.name: Toxic Horrors
text: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5087.name: Winterfall Runners
text: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

5088.name: Arikara
text: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.

5089.name: General Drakkisath's Command
text: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.

5090.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
text: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5091.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
text: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5092.name: Clear the Way
text: Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill.
Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5093.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
text: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

5094.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
text: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

5095.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
text: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

5096.name: Scarlet Diversions

explore.text: Destroy the command tent and plant the Scourge banner in the camp

text: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.
Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5097.name: All Along the Watchtowers
text: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5098.name: All Along the Watchtowers
text: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5102.name: General Drakkisath's Demise
text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

5103.name: Hot Fiery Death
text: Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!

5121.name: High Chief Winterfall
text: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.

5123.name: The Final Piece
text: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5124.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets
text: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

5126.name: Lorax's Tale
text: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

5127.name: The Demon Forge
text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

5128.name: Words of the High Chief
text: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

5141.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
text: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Peter Galen in Azshara.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5142.name: Little Pamela
text: Find Pamela Redpath.

5143.name: Tribal Leatherworking
text: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Caryssia Moonhunter in Feralas.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5144.name: Elemental Leatherworking
text: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Sarah Tanner in Searing Gorge.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5145.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
text: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5146.name: Elemental Leatherworking
text: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5147.name: Wanted - Arnak Grimtotem
text: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

5148.name: Tribal Leatherworking
text: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Se'Jib in Stranglethorn Vale.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5149.name: Pamela's Doll
text: Find Pamela's doll.

5151.name: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
text: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.

5152.name: Auntie Marlene
text: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

5153.name: A Strange Historian
text: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

5154.name: The Annals of Darrowshire
text: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

5155.name: Forces of Jaedenar
text: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5156.name: Verifying the Corruption

explore.text: Explore the craters in Shatter Scar Vale

text: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

5157.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
text: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5158.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
text: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

5159.name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
text: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5160.name: The Matron Protectorate
text: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.

5161.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
text: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.

5162.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
text: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

5163.name: Are We There, Yeti?
text: Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:
Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring)
Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris)
Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater)
When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

5164.name: Catalogue of the Wayward
text: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

5165.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
text: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

5166.name: Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight
text: To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.

5167.name: Legplates of the Chromatic Defier
text: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
5 Skin of Shadow.

5168.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
text: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

5181.name: Villains of Darrowshire
text: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

5201.name: Winterfall Intrusion
text: Rivern Frostwind wants you to slay 5 Winterfall Shaman and 5 Winterfall Ursa.

5202.name: A Strange Red Key
text: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

5203.name: Rescue From Jaedenar

explore.text: Protect Arko'narin out of Shadow Hold

text: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.

5204.name: Retribution of the Light
text: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

5206.name: Marauders of Darrowshire
text: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5210.name: Brother Carlin
text: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5211.name: Defenders of Darrowshire
text: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.
extraObjectives: Slay ghouls to free Darrowshire spirits

5212.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
text: Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

5213.name: The Active Agent
text: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

5214.name: The Great Ezra Grimm
text: Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

5215.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
text: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

5216.name: Target: Felstone Field
text: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5217.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
text: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5219.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
text: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5220.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
text: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5222.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
text: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5223.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
text: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5225.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
text: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5226.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
text: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5228.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
text: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5229.name: Target: Felstone Field
text: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5230.name: Return to the Bulwark
text: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5231.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
text: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5232.name: Return to the Bulwark
text: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5233.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
text: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5234.name: Return to the Bulwark
text: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5235.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
text: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5236.name: Return to the Bulwark
text: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5241.name: Uncle Carlin
text: Find Carlin Redpath.

5242.name: A Final Blow
text: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5243.name: Houses of the Holy
text: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

5244.name: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
text: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.

5245.name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
text: Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.

5246.name: Fragments of the Past
text: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

5247.name: Fragments of the Past
text: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

5248.name: Tormented By the Past
text: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.

5249.name: To Winterspring!
text: Find Starfall Village in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

5250.name: Starfall
text: Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

5251.name: The Archivist
text: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

5252.name: Remorseful Highborne
text: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.

5253.name: The Crystal of Zin-Malor
text: Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

5261.name: Eagan Peltskinner
text: Speak with Eagan Peltskinner.

5262.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
text: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

5263.name: Above and Beyond
text: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.

5264.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
text: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.

5265.name: The Argent Hold
text: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.

5281.name: The Restless Souls
text: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

5282.name: The Restless Souls
text: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!
Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

5283.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
text: To become an Armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Grumnus: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

5284.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
text: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Ironus: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

5301.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
text: To become an armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Okothos: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

5302.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
text: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

5305.name: Sweet Serenity
text: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

5306.name: Snakestone of the Shadow Huntress
text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.

5307.name: Corruption
text: Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

5321.name: The Sleeper Has Awakened

explore.text: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Maestra's Post

text: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

5341.name: Barov Family Fortune
text: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

5342.name: The Last Barov
text: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov.
Be warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.

5343.name: Barov Family Fortune
text: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.

5344.name: The Last Barov
text: Travel to the Bulwark - Horde territory - and assassinate Alexi Barov. Take his head and return to Weldon Barov.
Be warned, Alexi will probably be well protected by Horde filth.

5361.name: Family Tree
text: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

5381.name: Hand of Iruxos
text: Retrieve the Demon Box from Thunder Axe Fortress, and return it, along with the Demon Pick to Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village.

5382.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
text: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

5384.name: Kirtonos the Herald
text: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.

5385.name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
text: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.

5386.name: Catch of the Day
text: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.

5441.name: Lazy Peons
text: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.

5461.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
text: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

5462.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
text: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

5463.name: Menethil's Gift
text: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.

5464.name: Menethil's Gift
text: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

5465.name: Soulbound Keepsake
text: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

5466.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
text: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.

5481.name: Gordo's Task
text: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.

5482.name: Doom Weed
text: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

5501.name: Bone Collector
text: Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.

5502.name: A Warden of the Horde
text: Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.

5504.name: Mantles of the Dawn
text: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5507.name: Mantles of the Dawn
text: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5513.name: Mantles of the Dawn
text: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

5514.name: Mold Rhymes With...
text: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.

5515.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
text: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

5517.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
text: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

5518.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
text: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.

5521.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
text: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5522.name: Leonid Barthalomew
text: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

5524.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
text: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5526.name: Shards of the Felvine
text: Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

5527.name: A Reliquary of Purity
text: Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

5529.name: Plagued Hatchlings
text: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.

5531.name: Betina Bigglezink
text: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

5533.name: Scholomance
text: Speak with Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

5534.name: Kim'jael's "Missing" Equipment
text: Find Some Rune that the naga have in their possession in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to Kim'jael in Azshara.

5535.name: Spiritual Unrest
text: Destroy 6 Highborne Apparitions and 6 Highborne Lichlings before returning to Loh'atu in Azshara.

5536.name: A Land Filled with Hatred
text: Kill 6 Haldarr Satyr, 2 Haldarr Tricksters, 2 Haldarr Felsworn and then return to Loh'atu on the border of Ashenvale.

5537.name: Skeletal Fragments
text: Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

5538.name: Mold Rhymes With...
text: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.

5541.name: Ammo for Rumbleshot
text: Bring Rumbleshot's Ammo to Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh.

5542.name: Demon Dogs
text: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.

5543.name: Blood Tinged Skies
text: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

5544.name: Carrion Grubbage
text: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.

5545.name: A Bundle of Trouble
text: Bring 8 Bundles of Wood to Raelen at the Eastvale Logging Camp.

5561.name: Kodo Roundup
text: Bring five Tamed Kodos and the Kodo Kombobulator back to Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp.
extraObjectives: Lure the Kodos to Smeed Scrabblescrew.

5581.name: Portals of the Legion
text: Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven and return to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.

5582.name: Healthy Dragon Scale
text: Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

5601.name: Sister Pamela
text: Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.

5621.name: Garments of the Moon
text: Find Sentinel Shaya and heal her wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Laurna Morninglight in Dolanaar.

5622.name: In Favor of Elune

5623.name: In Favor of the Light

5624.name: Garments of the Light

5625.name: Garments of the Light

5649.name: In Favor of Spirituality

5651.name: In Favor of Darkness

text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

5678.name: Arcane Feedback
text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

5713.name: One Shot. One Kill.
text: Protect Sentinel Aynasha, then speak with Onaeya at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

5721.name: The Battle of Darrowshire
text: Place the Relic Bundle at the Darrowshire town square.
Prevent Davil Lightfire's death until the death of Horgus.
Prevent Captain Redpath's death until Redpath the Corrupted appears.
Defeat Redpath the Corrupted.
Speak with the spirit of Joseph Redpath when he appears at the town square, then speak with Pamela at her home.
extraObjectives: Place the Relic Bundle in the Town Square.

5722.name: Searching for the Lost Satchel
text: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.

5723.name: Testing an Enemy's Strength
text: Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

5724.name: Returning the Lost Satchel
text: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

5725.name: The Power to Destroy...
text: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.

5726.name: Hidden Enemies
text: Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

5727.name: Hidden Enemies
text: Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

5728.name: Hidden Enemies
text: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

5729.name: Hidden Enemies
text: Speak to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

5730.name: Hidden Enemies
text: Speak to Thrall in Orgrimmar and tell him what you've learned.

5741.name: Sceptre of Light
text: Get the Sceptre of Light and then return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.

5742.name: Redemption
text: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

5761.name: Slaying the Beast
text: Enter Ragefire Chasm and slay Taragaman the Hungerer, then bring his heart back to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

5762.name: Hemet Nesingwary
text: Take Kravel's Crate to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.

5763.name: Hunting in Stranglethorn
text: Bring Roon's Kodo Horn to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.

5781.name: Of Forgotten Memories
text: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
extraObjectives: Search the false grave for the Taelan's Hammer.

5801.name: Fire Plume Forged
text: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.
Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

5802.name: Fire Plume Forged
text: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.
Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5803.name: Araj's Scarab
text: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

5804.name: Araj's Scarab
text: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5805.name: Welcome!
text: Bring the Northshire Gift Voucher to Merissa Stilwell.

5821.name: Bodyguard for Hire

explore.text: Escort Gizelton Caravan past Kolkar Centaur Village

text: Escort the Gizelton Caravan past the Kolkar Centaur village. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.

5841.name: Welcome!
text: Bring the Coldridge Valley Gift Voucher to Yori Crackhelm.

5842.name: Welcome!

5843.name: Welcome!
text: Bring the Valley of Trials Gift Voucher to Magga.

5844.name: Welcome!
text: Bring the Camp Narache Gift Voucher to Vorn Skyseer.

5845.name: Of Lost Honor
text: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

5846.name: Of Love and Family
text: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

5847.name: Welcome!
text: Bring the Deathknell Gift Voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.

5848.name: Of Love and Family
text: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world.
Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.

5861.name: Find Myranda
text: Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.

5862.name: Scarlet Subterfuge
text: Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion. Travel to Hearthglen while under the Scarlet Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring.
Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.

5863.name: The Dunemaul Compound
text: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.

5881.name: Calling in the Reserves
text: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.

5892.name: Irondeep Supplies
text: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.

5893.name: Coldtooth Supplies
text: Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Horde Quatermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

5901.name: A Plague Upon Thee
text: Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

5902.name: A Plague Upon Thee
text: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.

5903.name: A Plague Upon Thee

5904.name: A Plague Upon Thee
text: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.

5921.name: Moonglade
text: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

5922.name: Moonglade

text: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

5930.name: Great Bear Spirit

5931.name: Back to Darnassus
text: Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.
extraObjectives: Talk to Silva Fil'naveth to fly back to Darnassus

5932.name: Back to Thunder Bluff
text: Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.
extraObjectives: Talk to Bunthen Plainswind to fly back to Thunder Bluff

5941.name: Return to Chromie
text: Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.

5942.name: Hidden Treasures
text: Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.

5943.name: Gizelton Caravan
