text: Escort the Gizelton Caravan through Mannoroc Coven. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.

5944.name: In Dreams
text: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.

5961.name: The Champion of the Banshee Queen
text: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is said to have taken up residence at the Marris Stead.

5981.name: Rampaging Giants
text: Rivern Frostwind wants you to kill 4 Frostmaul Giants and 4 Frostmaul Preservers.

6001.name: Body and Heart
text: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.
Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus when you are done.

6002.name: Body and Heart
text: Use the Cenarion Lunardust on the Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.
Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff when you are done.

6004.name: Unfinished Business
text: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6021.name: Zaeldarr the Outcast
text: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

6022.name: To Kill With Purpose
text: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.

6023.name: Unfinished Business
text: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6024.name: Hameya's Plea
text: Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.

6025.name: Unfinished Business

explore.text: Overlook Hearthglen from a high vantage point

text: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6026.name: That's Asking A Lot
text: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.
You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

6027.name: Book of the Ancients
text: Get the Book of the Ancients and return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.

6028.name: The Everlook Report
text: Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Pureheart at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

6029.name: The Everlook Report
text: Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

6030.name: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff
text: Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

6031.name: Runecloth
text: Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

6032.name: Sacred Cloth
text: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

6041.name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
text: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked.
Once you plant the bomb, leave the building and marvel at your handiwork.
By the way, Smokey's Special Compound is rather... unstable.

6042.name: Un-Life's Little Annoyances
text: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

6061.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Adult Plainstrider. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6062.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Dire Mottled Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar in Razor Hill.

6063.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Webwood Lurker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6064.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Large Crag Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6065.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6066.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6067.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6068.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.

6069.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.

6070.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.

6071.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6072.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6073.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6074.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6075.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6076.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6081.name: Training the Beast
text: Speak with Ormak Grimshot in Orgrimmar.

6082.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Armored Scorpid. Practice your skills, then return to Thotar at Razor Hill.

6083.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Surf Crawler. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar at Razor Hill.

6084.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Snow Leopard. Practice your skills, then return to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6085.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ice Claw Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6086.name: Training the Beast
text: Speak with Belia Thundergranite in Ironforge.

6087.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Prairie Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6088.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Swoop. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6089.name: Training the Beast
text: Speak with Holt Thunderhorn on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.

6101.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Nightsaber Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6102.name: Taming the Beast
text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Strigid Screecher. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6103.name: Training the Beast
text: Speak to Jocaste in the Cenarion Enclave, in Darnassus.

6121.name: Lessons Anew
text: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

6122.name: The Principal Source
text: Use the Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls.
Deliver the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine, Darkshore.

6123.name: Gathering the Cure
text: Bring 5 Earthroot and 12 Lunar Funguses to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine so she may make a curative salve.

6124.name: Curing the Sick
text: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Deer that are located throughout Darkshore; doing so should cure them. Sickly Deer have been reported starting south of the Cliffspring River to the north of Auberdine and extending all the way into southern Darkshore where the edge of Ashenvale begins.

6125.name: Power over Poison
text: Return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.

6126.name: Lessons Anew
text: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

6127.name: The Principal Source
text: Use the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler to draw a sample of water from a pool at the top of the peak.
Deliver the Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads, Barrens.

6128.name: Gathering the Cure
text: Bring 5 Earthroot and 5 Kodo Horns to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads so he may make a curative salve.

6129.name: Curing the Sick
text: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Gazelles that are located throughout the northern part of the Barrens; doing so should cure them. Sickly Gazelles have been reported north of the east-west road that runs through the Crossroads.

6130.name: Power over Poison
text: Return to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff.

6132.name: Get Me Out of Here!
text: Escort Melizza Brimbuzzle, then speak with Hornizz Brimbuzzle at the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace.

6133.name: The Ranger Lord's Behest
text: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.
You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

6134.name: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up
text: Bring 8 Ghost-o-plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in Desolace.
extraObjectives: Place the Crate of Ghost Magnets

6135.name: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
text: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller.
It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.

6136.name: The Corpulent One
text: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.

6141.name: Brother Anton
text: Speak with Brother Anton in Desolace.

6142.name: Clam Bait
text: Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.

6143.name: Other Fish to Fry
text: Slay 7 Slitherblade Myrmidon, 7 Slitherblade Naga, and 5 Slitherblade Sorceresses, and then talk to Drulzegar at Shadowprey in Desolace.

6144.name: The Call to Command
text: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.

6145.name: The Crimson Courier
text: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.
Take the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

6146.name: Nathanos' Ruse
text: Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.

6147.name: Return to Nathanos
text: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller with the new information.

6148.name: The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria
text: The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.

6161.name: Claim Rackmore's Treasure!
text: Find Rackmore's Silver Key. Find Rackmore's Golden Key. Find and open Rackmore's Chest.

6162.name: A Husband's Last Battle
text: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

6163.name: Ramstein
text: Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.

6164.name: Augustus' Receipt Book
text: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.

6181.name: A Swift Message
text: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.

6182.name: The First and the Last
text: Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town Stormwind. He resides in the Barracks.

6183.name: Honor the Dead
text: Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.

6184.name: Flint Shadowmore
text: Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.

6185.name: The Eastern Plagues
text: Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.

6186.name: The Blightcaller Cometh
text: Return to Stormwind and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of Nathanos Marris.

6187.name: Order Must Be Restored
text: Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands. Launch a full assault on Nathanos Blightcaller and any Horde filth that may attempt to protect him.
Keep your wits about you, <Name>. The Horde will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.

6261.name: Dungar Longdrink
text: Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.

6281.name: Continue to Stormwind
text: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Thor, then bring Lewis' Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.

6282.name: Harpies Threaten
text: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.

6283.name: Bloodfury Bloodline
text: Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.

6284.name: Arachnophobia
text: Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.

6285.name: Return to Lewis
text: Buy a gryphon ride to Sentinel Hill from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric's Crate to Lewis at Sentinel Hill.

6301.name: Cycle of Rebirth
text: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.

6321.name: Supplying the Sepulcher
text: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.

6322.name: Michael Garrett
text: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.

6323.name: Ride to the Undercity
text: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.

6324.name: Return to Podrig
text: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.

6341.name: The Bounty of Teldrassil
text: Bring Nessa's Collection to Vesprystus.

6342.name: Flight to Auberdine
text: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.

6343.name: Return to Nessa
text: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.

6344.name: Nessa Shadowsong
text: Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.

6361.name: A Bundle of Hides
text: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.

6362.name: Ride to Thunder Bluff
text: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.

6363.name: Tal the Wind Rider Master
text: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.

6364.name: Return to Jahan
text: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.

6365.name: Meats to Orgrimmar
text: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.

6381.name: New Life
text: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.

6382.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
text: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

6384.name: Ride to Orgrimmar
text: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

6385.name: Doras the Wind Rider Master
text: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.

6386.name: Return to the Crossroads.
text: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.

6387.name: Honor Students
text: Bring Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.

6388.name: Gryth Thurden
text: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.

6389.name: A Plague Upon Thee
text: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

6390.name: A Plague Upon Thee
text: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

6391.name: Ride to Ironforge
text: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.

6392.name: Return to Brock
text: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.

6393.name: Elemental War
text: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.

6394.name: Thazz'ril's Pick
text: Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.

6395.name: Marla's Last Wish
text: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.

6401.name: Kaya's Alive
text: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.

6402.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
text: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.

6403.name: The Great Masquerade
text: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

6421.name: Boulderslide Ravine
text: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

6441.name: Satyr Horns
text: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.

6442.name: Naga at the Zoram Strand
text: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.

6461.name: Blood Feeders
text: Xen'zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.

6462.name: Troll Charm
text: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.

6481.name: Earthen Arise
text: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.

6482.name: Freedom to Ruul
text: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.

6501.name: The Dragon's Eye
text: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.

6502.name: Drakefire Amulet
text: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.

6503.name: Ashenvale Outrunners
text: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.

6504.name: The Lost Pages
text: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

6521.name: An Unholy Alliance
text: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6522.name: An Unholy Alliance
text: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6523.name: Protect Kaya
text: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6541.name: Report to Kadrak
text: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

6542.name: Report to Kadrak
text: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

6543.name: The Warsong Reports
text: Open the Bundle of Reports. Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.

6544.name: Torek's Assault
text: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.

6548.name: Avenge My Village
text: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6561.name: Blackfathom Villainy
text: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

6562.name: Trouble in the Deeps
text: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6563.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
text: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6564.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
text: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6565.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
text: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6566.name: What the Wind Carries
text: Listen to Thrall.

6567.name: The Champion of the Horde
text: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.

6568.name: The Testament of Rexxar
text: Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.

6569.name: Oculus Illusions
text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.

6570.name: Emberstrife
text: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

6571.name: Warsong Supplies
text: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.

6582.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
text: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.
You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.

6583.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
text: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.

6584.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
text: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.

6585.name: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz
text: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

6601.name: Ascension...
text: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.

6602.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.

6603.name: Trouble in Winterspring!
text: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.

6604.name: Enraged Wildkin
text: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.

6605.name: A Strange One
text: Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.

6606.name: A Little Luck
text: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.

6607.name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
text: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
Misty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows.
A Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.
Feralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas.
Savage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!

6608.name: You Too Good.
text: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of Theramore (at least that's what you think Lumak said).

6609.name: I Got Nothin' Left!
text: Travel to Kalimdor, to the coastal city of Theramore. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!

6610.name: Clamlette Surprise
text: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:
12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird.
10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally!
20 pieces of Alterac Swiss. Get thee to a cheesery!
Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.

6611.name: To Gadgetzan You Go!
text: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

6612.name: I Know A Guy...
text: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

6621.name: King of the Foulweald
text: Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound. Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner. Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.

6622.name: Triage
text: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

6623.name: Horde Trauma
text: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Doctor Gregory Victor about joining the ranks of Horde Trauma.

6624.name: Triage
text: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

6625.name: Alliance Trauma
text: Travel to Theramore in the Dustwallow Marsh and speak with Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen about joining the ranks of Alliance Trauma.

6626.name: A Host of Evil
text: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.

6627.name: Test of Lore
text: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.

6628.name: Test of Lore
text: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the Undercity until you are ready.

6629.name: Kill Grundig Darkcloud
text: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6641.name: Vorsha the Lasher
text: Keep Muglash safe as he travels to the brazier. Help him by putting the brazier out, then protect him as you fight against the Naga.
If you are successful, return to the Zoram'gar Outpost and inform the Warsong Runner of the death of Vorsha the Lasher.

6642.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Dark Iron Ore

6643.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Fiery Core

6644.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Lava Core

6645.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Core Leather

6646.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Blood of the Mountain

6661.name: Deeprun Rat Roundup
text: Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the Rat Catcher's Flute. Lead the rats back to Monty. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.

6662.name: Me Brother, Nipsy
text: Take the Carton of Mystery Meat to Nipsy at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot.

6681.name: The Manor, Ravenholdt
text: Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad.
Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.

6721.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6722.name: The Hunter's Path
text: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6761.name: The New Frontier
text: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.

6762.name: Rabine Saturna
text: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.

6804.name: Poisoned Water
text: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands. Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6805.name: Stormers and Rumblers
text: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6821.name: Eye of the Emberseer
text: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6822.name: The Molten Core
text: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6823.name: Agent of Hydraxis
text: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6824.name: Hands of the Enemy
text: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6844.name: Umber, Archivist
text: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6845.name: Uncovering Past Secrets
text: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6847.name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
text: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

6848.name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
text: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

6921.name: Amongst the Ruins
text: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

6922.name: Baron Aquanis
text: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

6961.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
text: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

6962.name: Treats for Great-father Winter
text: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Greatfather Winter in Orgrimmar.

6963.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
text: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

6964.name: The Reason for the Season
text: Speak with Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom of Orgrimmar about the Feast of Winter Veil.

6981.name: The Glowing Shard
text: Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard.
Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

6982.name: Coldtooth Supplies
text: Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.

6983.name: You're a Mean One...
text: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

6984.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
text: Speak with Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.

6985.name: Irondeep Supplies
text: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Horde Quartermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

7001.name: Empty Stables
text: Locate a Frostwolf in Alterac Valley. Use the Frostwolf Muzzle when you are near the Frostwolf to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Frostwolf will follow you back to the Frostwolf Stable Master. Speak with the Frostwolf Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.

7003.name: Zapped Giants
text: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

7021.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
text: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

7022.name: Greatfather Winter is Here!
text: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.

7023.name: Greatfather Winter is Here!
text: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.

7024.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
text: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

7025.name: Treats for Greatfather Winter
text: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.

7027.name: Empty Stables
text: Locate an Alterac Ram in Alterac Valley. Use the Stormpike Training Collar when you are near the Alterac Ram to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Alterac Ram will follow you back to the Stable Master. Speak with the Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.

7028.name: Twisted Evils
text: Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

7029.name: Vyletongue Corruption
text: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

7041.name: Vyletongue Corruption
text: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Talendria in Nijel's Point.

7042.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
text: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

7043.name: You're a Mean One...
text: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

7044.name: Legends of Maraudon
text: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.
Find a way to speak with Celebras.

7045.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
text: Speak with Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.

7046.name: The Scepter of Celebras
text: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.
Speak with him when the ritual is complete.

7061.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
text: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

7062.name: The Reason for the Season
text: Speak with Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League in Ironforge about the Feast of Winter Veil.

7063.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
text: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

7064.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
text: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

7065.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
text: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

7066.name: Seed of Life
text: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

7067.name: The Pariah's Instructions
text: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

7068.name: Shadowshard Fragments
text: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.

7070.name: Shadowshard Fragments
text: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.

7081.name: Alterac Valley Graveyards
text: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7082.name: The Graveyards of Alterac
text: Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7101.name: Towers and Bunkers
text: Capture an enemy tower, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7102.name: Towers and Bunkers
text: Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7121.name: The Quartermaster
text: Speak with the Stormpike Quartermaster.

7122.name: Capture a Mine
text: Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7123.name: Speak with our Quartermaster
text: Speak with the Frostwolf Quartermaster.

7124.name: Capture a Mine
text: Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7141.name: The Battle of Alterac
text: Enter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the Alterac Mountains.

7142.name: The Battle for Alterac
text: Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike. Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.

7161.name: Proving Grounds
text: Travel to the Wildpaw cavern located southeast of the main base in Alterac Valley and find the Frostwolf Banner. Return the Frostwolf Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.

7162.name: Proving Grounds
text: Travel to the Icewing Caverns located southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley and recover the Stormpike Banner. Return the Stormpike Banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

7181.name: The Legend of Korrak
text: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Warmaster Laggrond.

7201.name: The Last Element
text: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.

7202.name: Korrak the Bloodrager
text: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

7221.name: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer
text: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer in the Dun Baldar garrison.

7222.name: Speak with Voggah Deathgrip
text: Speak with Voggah in Frostwolf Keep.

7223.name: Armor Scraps
text: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.

7224.name: Enemy Booty
text: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.

7241.name: In Defense of Frostwolf
text: Venture to Alterac Valley, located in the Alterac Mountains. Find and speak with Warmaster Laggrond - who stands outside the tunnel entrance - to begin your career as a soldier of Frostwolf. You will find Alterac Valley north of Tarren Mill at the base of the Alterac Mountains.

7261.name: The Sovereign Imperative
text: Travel to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Outside of the entrance tunnel, find and speak with Lieutenant Haggerdin.
For the glory of Bronzebeard!

7281.name: Brotherly Love
text: Travel into Stormpike territory and slay Commander Karl Philips. Return to Commander Louis Philips when the task is complete.

7282.name: Brotherly Love
text: Travel into Frostwolf territory and slay Commander Louis Philips. Return to Commander Karl Philips when the task is complete.

7301.name: Fallen Sky Lords
text: Travel to Frostwolf territory and search for Wing Commander Slidore, Wing Commander Vipore, and Wing Commander Ichman. Return to Commander Duffy should you complete your mission.

7302.name: Fallen Sky Lords
text: Find out what became of Wing Commander Guse, Wing Commander Jeztor, and Wing Commander Mulverick. Return to Commander Mulfort should you complete your mission.

7321.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
text: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

7361.name: Favor Amongst the Darkspear
text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing night elf players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a night elf and return to Najak Hexxen at Frostwolf Keep with a Severed Night Elf Head.

7362.name: Ally of the Tauren
text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing gnome players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a gnome and return to Ravak Grimtotem at Frostwolf Keep with a Tuft of Gnome Hair.

7363.name: The Human Condition
text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing human players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a human and return to Commander Louis Philips (who wanders between the front lines and Frostwolf keep) with a Human Bone Chip.
A cure for the human condition is close at hand!

7364.name: Gnomeregan Bounty
text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing tauren players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a tauren and return to Dirk Swindle at Dun'Baldar with a Tauren Hoof.

7365.name: Staghelm's Requiem
text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing troll players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a troll and return to Athramanis at Dun'Baldar with Darkspear Troll Mojo.

7366.name: The Archbishop's Mercy
text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Forsaken players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a Forsaken and return to Commander Karl Philips (who wanders between the lumber mill and the mine) with a Forsaken Heart.

7367.name: Defusing the Threat
text: Find the Frostwolf Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Stormpike Explosives Expert when the task is complete.

7368.name: Defusing the Threat
text: Find the Stormpike Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Frostwolf Explosives Expert when the task is complete.

7381.name: The Return of Korrak
text: Should Korrak the Bloodrager make a return to the Field of Strife, seek him out and destroy him.
Return the Skull of Korrak to Warmaster Laggrond in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

7382.name: Korrak the Everliving
text: Should Korrak the Bloodrager make a return to the Field of Strife, seek him out and destroy him.
Return the Skull of Korrak to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

7383.name: Crown of the Earth
text: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.

7401.name: Wanted: DWARVES!
text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Dwarf players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a Dwarf and rip out their spine. Take the Dwarf Spine to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl at Frostwolf Keep.

7402.name: Wanted: ORCS!
text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Orc players in Alterac Valley.
Kill an Orc and take their Orc Tooth back to Corporal Noreg Stormpike at Dun Baldar.

7423.name: I've Got A Fever For More Bone Chips

7441.name: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
text: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.

7461.name: The Madness Within
text: You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.
Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.
Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.

7462.name: The Treasure of the Shen'dralar
text: Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!

7463.name: Arcane Refreshment
text: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.

7481.name: Elven Legends
text: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.

7482.name: Elven Legends
text: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.

7483.name: Libram of Rapidity
text: Bring a Libram of Rapidity, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Blood of Heroes to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Rapidity.

7484.name: Libram of Focus
text: Bring a Libram of Focus, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 4 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Skin of Shadow to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Focus.

7485.name: Libram of Protection
text: Bring a Libram of Protection, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 1 Frayed Abomination Stitching to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Protection.

7486.name: A Hero's Reward
text: Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.

7488.name: Lethtendris's Web
text: Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

7489.name: Lethtendris's Web
text: Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

7490.name: Victory for the Horde
text: Take the Head of Onyxia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

7491.name: For All To See
text: Seek out Overlord Runthak in the Valley of Strength.

7492.name: Camp Mojache
text: Speak with Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

7494.name: Feathermoon Stronghold
text: Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

7495.name: Victory for the Alliance
text: Take the Head of Onyxia to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

7496.name: Celebrating Good Times
text: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.

7498.name: Garona: A Study on Stealth and Treachery
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7499.name: Codex of Defense
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7500.name: The Arcanist's Cookbook
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7501.name: The Light and How To Swing It
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7502.name: Harnessing Shadows
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7503.name: The Greatest Race of Hunters
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7504.name: Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7505.name: Frost Shock and You
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7506.name: The Emerald Dream...
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7507.name: Nostro's Compendium
text: Return Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.

7508.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
text: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.

7509.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
text: You must get Onyxia to breathe fire on the Unfired Ancient Blade. Once this is done, pick up the now Heated Ancient Blade. Be warned, a Heated Ancient Blade will not remain heated forever - time is of the essence.
The last step before returning to me is to slay the beast and drive the Heated Ancient Blade into her corpse.
Do this and Quel'Serrar will be yours.

7562.name: Mor'zul Bloodbringer
text: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

7563.name: Rage of Blood
text: Bring 30 bottles of Raging Beast's Blood to Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

7564.name: Wildeyes
text: Bring the Case of Blood to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7581.name: The Prison's Bindings
text: Travel to Dire Maul in Feralas and recover 15 Satyr Blood from the Wildspawn Satyr that inhabit the Warpwood Quarter. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when this is done.

7582.name: The Prison's Casing
text: Travel to Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring and recover 5 Tears of the Hederine from the Hederine demons that occupy the gorge. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when you have completed this task.

7583.name: Suppression
text: Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander.
Use the Glowing Crystal Prison on the Doomguard Commander. Be prepared for a ferocious onslaught of attacks, as the demon attempts to escape capture.
Should you succeed, return the Imprisoned Doomguard to Daio in the Tainted Scar.

7601.name: What Niby Commands
text: Speak with Impsy in Felwood.

7602.name: Flawless Fel Essence
text: Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations.

The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the Blasted Lands hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region.
Recover the Flawless Fel Essences and return to Impsy in Felwood.

7603.name: Kroshius' Infernal Core
text: Search Shatter Scar Vale in Felwood for the remains of Kroshius. When you locate the remains, use the Fel Fire near them and await Kroshius' return. When the infernal has awoken, slay him and take from his corpse Kroshius' Infernal Core.
Return Kroshius' Infernal Core to Niby the Almighty in Felwood.

7604.name: A Binding Contract
text: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.

7622.name: The Balance of Light and Shadow

explore.text: The Balance of Light and Shadow

text: Save 50 Peasants before 15 are slain. Speak with Eris Havenfire should you accomplish this task.
You may view the Death Post to view how many Peasants have been slain.

7623.name: Lord Banehollow
text: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.

7624.name: Ulathek the Traitor
text: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.

7625.name: Xorothian Stardust
text: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan. Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7626.name: Bell of Dethmoora
text: Bring 10 Elixirs of Shadow Power to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7627.name: Wheel of the Black March
text: Bring 6 Large Brilliant Shards and 25 Dark Iron Ore to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

7628.name: Doomsday Candle
text: Bring 35 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7629.name: Imp Delivery
text: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance. After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.

7630.name: Arcanite
text: Bring 3 Arcanite Bar to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

7631.name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth
text: Read Mor'zul's Instructions. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.

7632.name: The Ancient Leaf
text: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, <Name>; It's a big world.

7634.name: Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina
text: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.

7635.name: A Proper String
text: Stoma the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Black Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in Felwood.

7636.name: Stave of the Ancients
text: You must find and destroy these four demonic corrupters:
Simone the Seductress.
Klinfran the Crazed.
Solenor the Slayer.
Artorius the Doombringer.
Destroy these creatures and return to Vartrus the Ancient in Felwood with their heads.
Refer to the Petrified Bark in your inventory for clues as to their whereabouts.
You MUST complete this task by yourself.

7637.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
text: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's Exorcism Censer. You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.

7638.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
text: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

7639.name: To Show Due Judgment
text: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7640.name: Exorcising Terrordale
text: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale. When you have slain 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7641.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
text: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

7642.name: Collection of Goods
text: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

7643.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
text: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Merideth Carlson in Southshore apparently is the source for such food.

Travel to the Dire Maul dungeon in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed, thereby soothing the spirit. Finally, give it the Arcanite Barding so it may bless it.

7644.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
text: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7645.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
text: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits.
You also need to give her 50 gold to soothe her ruffled sensibilities.

7646.name: The Divination Scryer
text: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7647.name: Judgment and Redemption
text: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.
Give the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.

7648.name: Grimand's Finest Work
text: Take the Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District for his inspection.

7649.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume I
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7650.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume II
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7651.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume III
text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7667.name: Material Assistance
text: If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.

7668.name: The Darkreaver Menace
text: Bring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.

7670.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
text: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

7677.name: White Stallion Exchange
text: If you bring me your white stallion, I'll trade you for one from the new herd. The new horse will be just as fast as your old one, but have a different look to it. You can look at the swift steeds here to see what it will look like.
MUST PAY 500 Gold too....

7701.name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
text: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.
Slay Overseer Maltorius and take his head. Return the head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in the Searing Gorge for your reward.

7703.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
text: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.

7704.name: Look at the Size of It!
text: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.

7721.name: Fuel for the Zapping
text: Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

7722.name: What the Flux?
text: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.

7723.name: Curse These Fat Fingers
text: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.
The Heavy War Golems wander the areas surrounding the Cauldron in the Searing Gorge. When you've killed enough, return to Hansel in Searing Gorge.

7724.name: Fiery Menace!
text: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.

7725.name: Again With the Zapped Giants
text: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 10 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

7726.name: Refuel for the Zapping
text: Collect 6 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

7727.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
text: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.
You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.

7728.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
text: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.

The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.

7729.name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
text: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.

7730.name: Zukk'ash Infestation

7731.name: Stinglasher

7732.name: Zukk'ash Report

7733.name: Improved Quality

7734.name: Improved Quality

7735.name: Pristine Yeti Hide

7738.name: Perfect Yeti Hide

text: That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.

7787.name: Rise, Thunderfury!

7816.name: Gammerita, Mon!
text: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.
Katoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.

7828.name: Stalking the Stalkers
text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Silvermane Stalkers and 10 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7829.name: Hunt the Savages
text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7830.name: Avenging the Fallen
text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7839.name: Vilebranch Hooligans
text: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.
You recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.

7840.name: Lard Lost His Lunch
text: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.
Lard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.

7841.name: Message to the Wildhammer
text: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete.
You can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.

7842.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
text: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.
Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.

7843.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
text: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.
Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance.

7844.name: Cannibalistic Cousins
text: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.
Yayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

7845.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
text: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.
You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.

7846.name: Recover the Key!
text: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.

7847.name: Return to Primal Torntusk

7848.name: Attunement to the Core

7849.name: Separation Anxiety
text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.

Markhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.

7850.name: Dark Vessels
